How Long Does a Custom Kitchen Take? From Measurement to Installation

Key takeaways

  • You get an estimate within 24 hours of your request.
  • Production takes up to 6 weeks after final design approval and the first deposit.
  • Delivery and installation are scheduled after you inspect the finished cabinets.

Step 1: Request and estimate

Send the form or call. We reply within 24 hours, talk through your room, style, and budget, and book a free measurement.

Step 2: Measurement and 3D design

We measure your space and prepare a free 3D design with materials, colors, and hardware. Two rounds of changes are included. How long this step takes depends mostly on how quickly you decide. Measurements are verified on site before anything is released to production.

Step 3: Production, up to 6 weeks

Production starts after you approve the final design and pay the first deposit, and takes up to 6 weeks in our Oldsmar shop. Your timeline is confirmed in the contract.

Step 4: Inspection, delivery, and installation

When the cabinets are ready, you can inspect them before delivery. Our own team then delivers and installs them, and you get one point of contact from start to finish.

What can slow a project down

  • Design changes after approval.
  • Appliances that are not chosen or not delivered yet.
  • Other trades, such as plumbing, electrical, or countertops, that are not ready on site.
  • Condo or HOA access rules that limit delivery days.
